hints.title: Incremental Subarray Gaps
hints.text: Consider each subarray starting point i and expand rightward one element at a time.

hints.title: Neighbor Connectivity
hints.text: Inserting a new number x bridges a gap if both x minus one and x plus one are already present.

hints.title: Isolated Element Gap Creation
hints.text: Inserting x creates an additional gap if neither neighboring value has been observed.

hints.title: Incremental Set Code

complexity.notes: Incremental element insertion computes subarray imbalance in O(1) per step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting each subarray takes O(n^3 log n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean array tracks seen numbers in the current window.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains running imbalance by inspecting neighbor existence.
